fields.label: Missed-strong-performer rate
fields.operation_and_denominator: Among people who meet a predeclared independent high-performance criterion and have outcome opportunity, `N(not selected by policy at C) / N(strong performers)`; compare all policies at the same C and report outcome missingness.
